name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

summary.oneLiner: Collateral-free working capital loans for street vendors, starting at ₹10,000.
summary.whatIsIt: PM SVANidhi gives street vendors small loans to restock their business, without needing any collateral. You must be a street vendor with a vending certificate or letter of recommendation from your local body. Repay your first loan on time and you can apply for a bigger one next, along with an interest subsidy and cashback for digital payments.

benefits.text: Collateral-free working capital loan, first tranche
Interest subsidy on timely repayment, plus cashback for digital payments

whoCanApply: You have a vending certificate or letter of recommendation

documents.name: Vending certificate or letter of recommendation (LOR)

howToApply.title: Apply through the PM SVANidhi portal or app
howToApply.detail: Register with your Aadhaar and vending certificate or LOR details.

howToApply.title: Get your loan sanctioned by a lender
howToApply.detail: Banks, NBFCs, or micro-finance institutions process and disburse the loan.

howToApply.title: Repay on time to unlock bigger loans
howToApply.detail: Timely repayment makes you eligible for the next, larger loan tranche.

rules.label: You are a street vendor
rules.sourceQuote: Street vendors in possession of a Certificate of Vending or Identity Card issued by Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) are eligible.

customQuestion.en: Do you have a vending certificate or a letter of recommendation from your local body?
customQuestion.hi: क्या आपके पास वेंडिंग सर्टिफिकेट या स्थानीय निकाय से सिफारिश पत्र है?
customQuestion.te: మీ వద్ద వెండింగ్ సర్టిఫికేట్ లేదా స్థానిక సంస్థ నుండి సిఫార్సు లేఖ ఉందా?
customQuestion.ta: உங்களிடம் விற்பனை சான்றிதழ் அல்லது உள்ளூர் அமைப்பின் பரிந்துரைக் கடிதம் உள்ளதா?

rules.label: You have a vending certificate or letter of recommendation
rules.sourceQuote: Vendors who have not been formally identified, or who do not have a Certificate of Vending, may obtain a Letter of Recommendation (LOR) from the ULB.

jargon.meaning: No property or valuables need to be pledged to get the loan.
A letter from your local municipal body confirming you are a recognised vendor.
One instalment of a loan given in stages as earlier ones are repaid.

documentGaps: The exact list of documents accepted as proof of vending in each city is not detailed here.
